name: Kannagi Rito
source:
Kannagi Rito, the chairman of Amatsuhara Private Academy. She inherited the title from [url=/c1410]Seika[/url]’s grandfather which acts as her guardian after she broke her relationship with the Kannagi family. Ever since a little girl, she is very wise and calculative in her every action. But meeting [url=/c1376]Shin'ya[/url] has changed something within her heart.

[Edited from [url=http://hodohodonine.wordpress.com/2008/11/05/concerto-note-wrap-up/]Kresnik's review[/url].]
